role_applications_one_open_scoped_uk.name: role_applications_one_open_scoped_uk
role_applications_one_open_scoped_uk.where: status IN ('submitted', 'under_review') AND scope_id IS NOT NULL

role_applications_one_open_national_uk.name: role_applications_one_open_national_uk
role_applications_one_open_national_uk.where: status IN ('submitted', 'under_review') AND scope_id IS NULL

entitlements_subject_active_uk.name: entitlements_subject_active_uk
entitlements_subject_active_uk.where: status = 'active' and subject_id is not null

seller_verifications_expiry_idx.name: seller_verifications_expiry_idx
seller_verifications_expiry_idx.where: status = 'verified' and expires_at is not null

return_requests_due_idx.name: return_requests_due_idx
return_requests_due_idx.where: seller_responded_at is null and respond_by is not null

seller_orders_dispatch_due_idx.name: seller_orders_dispatch_due_idx
seller_orders_dispatch_due_idx.where: dispatched_at is null and dispatch_by is not null

payout_adjustments_pending_idx.name: payout_adjustments_pending_idx
payout_adjustments_pending_idx.where: applied_at is null and approved_at is not null

concession_applications_award_ck.name: concession_applications_award_ck
concession_applications_award_ck.value:
"concession_applications"."awarded_basis" IS NULL
		OR ("concession_applications"."awarded_basis" = 'fixed_amount' AND "concession_applications"."awarded_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "concession_applications"."awarded_percent_ppm" IS NULL)
		OR ("concession_applications"."awarded_basis" = 'percentage' AND "concession_applications"."awarded_percent_ppm" IS NOT NULL AND "concession_applications"."awarded_amount_minor" IS NULL)

concession_policies_basis_ck.name: concession_policies_basis_ck
concession_policies_basis_ck.value:
("concession_policies"."basis" = 'fixed_amount' AND "concession_policies"."amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "concession_policies"."percent_ppm" IS NULL)
		OR ("concession_policies"."basis" = 'percentage' AND "concession_policies"."percent_ppm" IS NOT NULL AND "concession_policies"."amount_minor" IS NULL)

discount_approvals_self_ck.name: discount_approvals_self_ck
discount_approvals_self_ck.value:
"discount_approvals"."decided_by_user_id" IS NULL
		OR "discount_approvals"."requested_by_user_id" IS NULL
		OR "discount_approvals"."decided_by_user_id" <> "discount_approvals"."requested_by_user_id"

discount_eligibility_subject_ck.name: discount_eligibility_subject_ck
discount_eligibility_subject_ck.value:
("discount_eligibility"."subject_id" IS NOT NULL AND "discount_eligibility"."subject_value" IS NULL)
		OR ("discount_eligibility"."subject_id" IS NULL AND "discount_eligibility"."subject_value" IS NOT NULL)

discount_rules_basis_ck.name: discount_rules_basis_ck
discount_rules_basis_ck.value:
("discount_rules"."basis" = 'fixed_amount' AND "discount_rules"."amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "discount_rules"."percent_ppm" IS NULL)
		OR ("discount_rules"."basis" = 'percentage' AND "discount_rules"."percent_ppm" IS NOT NULL AND "discount_rules"."amount_minor" IS NULL)
